lines.rom: jaya siddhidatri mam tu siddhi ki data tu bhaktom ki raksaka tu dasom ki mata tera nama lete hi milati hai siddhi tere nama se mana ki hoti hai suddhi
kathina kama siddha karati ho tuma jabhi hatha sevaka ke sira dharati ho tuma teri puja mem to na koi vidhi hai tu jagadambe dati tu sarvasiddhi hai
ravivara ko tera sumirana kare jo teri murti ko hi mana mem dhare jo tu saba kaja usake karati hai pure kabhi kama usake rahe na adhure
tumhari daya aura tumhari yaha maya rakhe jisake sira para maiya apani chaya sarvasiddhi dati vaha hai bhagyasali jo hai tere dara ka hi ambe savali
